# ButtonBaseNL's configuration tests query the panel before it renders

## Context

`ButtonBaseNL`'s two configuration tests are red in 3 of 5 Brain-gated hosted samples, and always together. They belong to the intermittent set that stands between #19657 and its green streak ([analysis](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19657#issuecomment-6130780202)).

## The Problem

`User-Driven Configuration Mutation` (`:47`) and `Agent-Driven Configuration Mutation` (`:75`) both do the same thing:
- wait a fixed 500 ms after `page.goto`, then connect;
- query `{ntype: 'textfield', labelText: 'text'}` once.

When the example's configuration panel has not rendered yet, the query returns nothing:
- `:47` fails with `Received: 0`;
- `:75` throws reading `results[0].id`.

The file's first test waits on its own condition (`.neo-button` visible) and has not failed in any sample.

## The Architectural Reality

- `test/playwright/e2e/rendering/ButtonBaseNL.spec.mjs:47` and `:75`.
- `app.queryComponent` is one Neural Link request with no wait. Playwright's auto-wait covers locators, not NL queries.
- The fixed-sleep lint only flags waits of 1000 ms or more, so this 500 ms wait never tripped it.

## The Fix

In both tests, poll the same query with `expect.poll` until the field exists, and drop their fixed 500 ms waits.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Both tests wait for the `text` field through the same NL query before using it, and no fixed wait remains in them.
- [ ] A hosted A/B on one runner, interleaved, shows the old tests red at least once and the new ones never.

## Out of Scope

The file's other two tests, and the rest of the intermittent set (#19657).
